mapper.sql: select d.*, p.project_name, p.status project_status, w.wbs_name work_package_name, t.type_name deliverable_type_name, w.owner_id work_package_owner_id, w.owner_user_id work_package_owner_user_id, u.nick_name work_package_owner_name, u.user_name work_package_owner_code, u.user_name work_package_owner_user_name from pm_project_deliverable d join pm_project p on p.project_id = d.project_id join pm_project_wbs_node w on w.wbs_id = d.work_package_id left join pm_project_deliverable_type t on t.type_id = d.deliverable_type_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = w.owner_user_id and u.del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into pm_project_deliverable(project_id, work_package_id, deliverable_name, deliverable_type, deliverable_type_id, submission_mode, allowed_extensions, required_flag, approval_required, status, description, planned_date, acceptance_criteria, create_by, create_time) values(#{projectId}, #{workPackageId}, #{deliverableName}, #{deliverableType}, #{deliverableTypeId}, #{submissionMode}, #{allowedExtensions}, #{requiredFlag}, #{approvalRequired}, #{status}, #{description}, #{plannedDate}, #{acceptanceCriteria}, #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.update: update pm_project_deliverable set work_package_id = #{workPackageId}, deliverable_name = #{deliverableName}, deliverable_type = #{deliverableType}, deliverable_type_id = #{deliverableTypeId}, submission_mode = #{submissionMode}, allowed_extensions = #{allowedExtensions}, required_flag = #{requiredFlag}, approval_required = #{approvalRequired}, description = #{description}, planned_date = #{plannedDate}, acceptance_criteria = #{acceptanceCriteria}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where deliverable_id = #{deliverableId}

update pm_project_deliverable set status = #{status}, submit_by = #{submitBy}, latest_file_url = #{latestFileUrl}, latest_external_url = #{latestExternalUrl}, update_time = sysdate() where deliverable_id = #{deliverableId}
mapper.delete: delete from pm_project_deliverable where deliverable_id in #{id}
mapper.select: select count(*) from pm_project_deliverable where work_package_id = #{workPackageId} and required_flag = '1' and ((approval_required = '0' and status != 'DELIVERED') or (approval_required = '1' and status != 'APPROVED'))
select count(*) from pm_project_deliverable where work_package_id = #{workPackageId} and required_flag = '1'
select coalesce(max(version_no), 0) + 1 from pm_project_deliverable_submission where deliverable_id = #{deliverableId}
mapper.insert: insert into pm_project_deliverable_submission(deliverable_id, version_no, file_url, external_url, submit_by, submit_time, review_result) values(#{deliverableId}, #{versionNo}, #{fileUrl}, #{externalUrl}, #{submitBy}, sysdate(), #{reviewResult})
mapper.update: update pm_project_deliverable_submission set review_result = #{reviewResult}, review_comment = #{reviewComment}, review_by = #{reviewBy}, review_time = sysdate() where submission_id = #{submissionId}
